create_Projection_module: create a Projection module that applies a 3x4 camera projection matrix to 3D vertices
create_LookAt_module: create a LookAt module that transforms vertices using a camera eye position with perspective or orthogonal projection
create_Look_module: create a Look module that transforms vertices using a camera eye position and direction vector
build_Transform_pipeline: build a Transform pipeline that applies projection, look, or look_at camera modes to a mesh
test_Transform_set_eyes: test the Transform class set_eyes_from_angles method to position the camera using spherical coordinates
